gen-gf-delius-unicase-poppins: Delius Unicase spaces letters like rungs on a rope ladder, no tapering, a pronounced x-height, relaxed and inviting. Poppins drops a point, a plain sans with rope-loose curves.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-rubik: Rubik keeps lowercase looking big next to the capitals, round letters still clear when small. Rubik prefers a smaller size under Delius Unicase, a handwritten line with no tapering.
gen-gf-dynapuff-fs-asap: Open-arc c forms and almost cap-high bodies give Asap a readable, easy line from the first word. Asap prefers a smaller size under DynaPuff, whose letters sit alone.
gen-gf-finger-paint-fs-asap: Bodies so high the capitals seem barely taller mark Finger Paint, chalk-wide gaps throughout. Asap prefers a smaller size, open-arc c forms, almost matching the caps.
gen-gf-finger-paint-fs-supreme: Chalk-wide gaps and nearly cap-high bodies: Finger Paint, commanding and bold. And Supreme holds a sans-serif column, while Finger Paint lives in a short, large line.
gen-gf-finger-paint-montserrat: Crossbars matching stems, chalk-wide gaps: Finger Paint, a commanding, bold display. Montserrat holds a plain sans column, while Finger Paint belongs up top, huge and brief.
gen-gf-finger-paint-switzer: Nearly cap-high bodies with chalk-wide gaps shout Finger Paint, commanding and bold. Switzer prefers a smaller size, a sans-serif with tubular letters and c tips that never meet.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-julius-sans-one: One-nib letters with terminals cut open: Gabarito, expressive and distinctive. And Julius Sans One drops a point, a sans-serif with matching cases and letters standing far apart.
gen-gf-gugi-noto-serif: Gugi nearly reaches the capitals, terminals cut open, curves matching stems. Noto Serif prefers a smaller size, a classic serif with a faint thick-thin cadence and a prominent x-height.
gen-gf-iceberg-fs-fira-sans: Zero thick-thin contrast and wide-open s curves give Fira Sans a clean, easy read. And Fira Sans prefers a smaller size under Iceberg, whose marker-tip letters keep large eyes.
gen-gf-iceberg-montserrat: Marker-tip letters with large lowercase eyes: Iceberg, expressive and bold on the heading, a display shout. Montserrat drops a point, a geometric sans-serif with oversized counters.
gen-gf-margarine-satoshi: Pen-plotter smoothness, lowercase looking big: Margarine, distinctive and commanding. Satoshi likes a slightly smaller size, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-manrope: Wide-mouthed letters on a high body with short stems: MedievalSharp, bold and commanding on the heading. Manrope holds the sans column, while MedievalSharp stays large and brief.
gen-gf-nova-square-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps generous space between curve ends and the stem, sharp and refined. And Nova Square belongs in a short shout of large letters, contrast-free from stem to terminal.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-roboto-slab: A middle zone that dominates the line gives Roboto Slab a precise, structured slab-serif read. Roboto Slab holds a column, while Over the Rainbow belongs in a short shout of large letters.
